_notes_roles: What a class is for. A class without a role is combat. civilian = a civilian or support ship (unarmed or lightly armed; the page lists them apart and the checks count them). cost, build and crew scale the formula's cost, build_seconds and crew_cost for that role (see _notes_costing); tech = a tech the role needs on top of the hull's (taken when it is the higher tier). A class on the civilian hull must have one of that hull's roles.
_notes_costing: How tools/ship_costs.py derives every class's cost, build_seconds, crew_cost and requires_tech (or requires_assimilated) from its hull and role; run python3 tools/ship_costs.py --write after changing these numbers or a class's hull/role. s = hull size, m = the role's multiplier. cost: per_size2 × s² + per_size × s (from from_size) + per_size_over × (s − over) (above over), each × m.cost, amounts of 20 or more rounded to round_to, smaller ones to whole numbers, zero left out. build_seconds = (base + per_size_pow × s^pow) × m.build, rounded to round_to. crew_cost = crew_per_sqrt_complement × √(hull crew) × m.crew, rounded, at least 1 and at most the hull's crew: the hull's crew stays the canon complement (lore); crew_cost is what the crew resource pays (start stock 150, a Colony Hub makes 6 a minute and a Habitat Dome 10). requires_tech: tech_band_by_size gives the hull's band (null = a starter hull, no gate), capped at the class's era tech_cap_tier (eras.json) so every class can be built in the era it enters service; tech_ladder names the tech for that tier; the role's tech is used instead when it is a higher tier (or the hull has no band). A faction listed in no_research (tech_tree faction_rules research: false) gets requires_tech null and requires_assimilated from its own ladder (a tech the Collective must hold, by assimilation or by combining for nanoprobes), and its cost swaps resources per swap. A class with "tuned": true is left alone by the tool and by the page's formula check. All numbers are placeholders for balancing.
